outline: 本課程在訓練學生了解無線傳輸系統和使用電腦輔助設計軟体來設計無線傳輸元件
schedule:
Ch1: Introduction to wireless communication from the aspects of system
Ch2: Basic Concepts in RF Design
Ch3: Modulation and Detection
Ch4: Multiple Access Techniques and Wireless Standards
Ch5: Transceiver Architechtures
Ch6: Low-Noise Amplifiers and Mixers
Ch7: Oscillators
Ch8: Frequency Synthesizer
Ch9: Power Amplifier
assessment:
Homework: 30%
Project1: 30%
Project2: 30%
In-Class performance: 10% (不定時點名)
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

使用外文原文書：

1. Textbook:  RF Microelectronics, Prentice-Hall, 1998. Behzad Razavi.
2. 有要加選同學，請帶選課單到綜科館 312-3 室找老師簽名，班級要滿5人才能開班。
